latest.title: Version 1.2.0
highlights: ESX support. Job rules, grades and onDuty now work with es_extended, alongside Qbox and QBCore. ESX has no gangs, so gang rules still need Qbox or QBCore.
Whitelists accept ESX character identifiers, such as char1:2f8a…, and a server ID whitelists an ESX player's current character.
